description: Sovereignty Hub cleanup window after a claim (manifest D07). Needs a world where Sov Attacker (account sovatk, a Director of its corporation) claimed WUZ-WM under 24 hours ago and the old owner's Orbital Skyhooks are still there, as the Phase 10 siege leaves it. Through the window's own calls (cleanupWndController.ProcessSkyhooks): with an empty corp wallet a conversion is refused with NotEnoughMoney; after a 1B ISK deposit the first listed skyhook converts for 200M and the second is destroyed; the converted one shows the attacker's corp and alliance, the destroyed one leaves the ballpark and both leave the cleanup list.

setup.note: the claiming Director on its own account
the window's own gate: a claim under 24 h old and at least two foreign skyhooks

setup.clientEval: agent.sov_pick = [c[0] for c in sov_cleanup_candidates()][:2]; agent.sov_pick
setup.note: the first two skyhooks the window lists
with less than the fee in the wallet, conversion is refused with NotEnoughMoney
the wallet's Give ISK to the corporation (the fee comes from the master wallet)
convert the first, destroy the second
one converted to the attacker for 200M, one gone from the ballpark, neither still listed

expect.note: the cleanup calls raise nothing in the client
nor in the cleanup window code
